Part B Script (to be read)
Invented news.
⁧أَهْلًا بِكُمْ فِي مُوجَزِ الأَخْبَارِ. اُخْتُتِمَتْ أَمْسِ فِي العَاصِمَةِ مُبَاحَثَاتُ وُزَرَاءِ النَّقْلِ فِي دُوَلِ المِنْطَقَةِ،⁩
⁧وَأَفَادَ مُرَاسِلُنَا أَنَّ الوُزَرَاءَ اتَّفَقُوا عَلَى دِرَاسَةِ خَطٍّ جَدِيدٍ لِلْقِطَارَاتِ يَرْبِطُ العَوَاصِمَ الثَّلَاثَ، عَلَى أَنْ⁩
⁧عَلَى صَعِيدٍ آخَرَ، اِنْدَلَعَ فَجْرَ اليَوْمِ حَرِيقٌ فِي سُوقٍ لِلْمَلَابِسِ قُرْبَ⁩ — ⁧يُفْتَتَحَ فِي غُضُونِ عَشْرِ سَنَوَاتٍ.⁩
⁧المَحَطَّةِ، وَتَمَكَّنَ رِجَالُ الإِطْفَاءِ مِنْ إِخْمَادِهِ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثِ سَاعَاتٍ. وَلَمْ تُسَجَّلْ أَيُّ إِصَابَاتٍ، إِلَّا أَنَّ الخَسَائِرَ⁩
⁧وَفِي الطَّقْسِ، تَتَوَقَّعُ الأَرْصَادُ الجَوِّيَّةُ هُطُولَ أَمْطَارٍ غَزِيرَةٍ فِي الشَّمَالِ، وَتَسَاقُطَ الثُّلُوجِ عَلَى⁩ — ⁧كَبِيرَةٌ.⁩
⁧المُرْتَفَعَاتِ الَّتِي يَزِيدُ ارْتِفَاعُهَا عَلَى أَلْفِ مِتْرٍ، بَيْنَمَا يَبْقَى الطَّقْسُ صَحْوًا فِي الجَنُوبِ.⁩
⁧العَوَاصِم⁩ pl. of ⁧عَاصِمَة⁩ The capital of the Bank shall be the following:
A · Reading
1. A title with the verb to the imperfect (present journalistic, like 1). The municipality announced a plan from 20
millions of dollars to restore the old popular markets, which in recent years have lost many visitors; the work will start at the beginning of next year and will last three years.
2. The repair of roofs and passageways, parking lots, and a traditional craft centre where the old
craftsmen teach young people the crafts of fathers and grandparents.
3. Traders, because they think the plan will bring back life to the markets. Some inhabitants fear the increase
rents after restoration, which could force small shops to leave. The municipality responds that it will allocate part of the budget to support the owners of small shops.
4. It dates back to the 16th century, and two years ago a part was closed after the collapse of a roof. ⁧يُعَلِّمُ⁩ Singer (II)

D · Translation · Model version
1. Yesterday the Ministry of Health denied news of a drug shortage, ensuring that supplies
That's enough for six months.
2. Moving on, millions of voters voted for enhanced security measures.
3. Despite the heavy rains, work on the bridge is progressing at full speed and should
End before summer.
4. The museum has a new director: his predecessor had resigned as a result of the controversy over the budget.
5. The opposition, for its part, threw gasoline on the fire, accusing the government of hiding the actual data.

How to assign Accuracy. 4: all five correct in the sense. 3: an inaccurate detail (e.g. 1 "Confirming" instead of "insuring" is fine; The stocks were sufficient in the past is an inaccurate detail). 2: an error that changes a part of the meaning (for example, in 2, the voters gave their voices without understanding the vote; in 4, has appointed a new director with the director as a subject, reading ⁧عَيَّنَ⁩ instead of ⁧عُيِّنَ⁩ ; in 5, a literal translation of the idiom that makes sense incomprehensible). 1: two or more errors of sense. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧مُؤَكِّدَةً⁩ is a ḥāl related to the Ministry (female); in 2 ⁧أَدْلَى بِأَصْوَاتِهِمْ⁩ is the journalistic formula for voting, and ⁧وَسَطَ⁩ In a climate of ... in 3 ⁧مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ أَنْ⁩ It should, it is likely that it will, in 4 ⁧عُيِّنَ⁩ is passive, ⁧قَدَّمَ⁩ is the form (object ⁧اِسْتِقَالَتَهُ⁩ ), e ⁧بَعْدَ أَنْ⁩ with the perfect indicates an earlier event (it had resigned) in 5 ⁧أَمَّا⁩ … ⁧فَقَدْ⁩ is rendered by its own side, and ⁧إِذْ⁩ with the gerunds, accusing them.
E · Written production · model
Invented news: the data does not refer to a real event.
⁧ثَقَافَة⁩
⁧لِلتَّرْمِيمِ⁩ « ⁧المَكْتَبَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ⁩ » ⁧إِغْلَاقُ⁩
⁧الأَعْمَالُ تَسْتَمِرُّ عَامًا كَامِلًا⁩ : ⁧البَلَدِيَّةُ⁩
⁧فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ ابْتِدَاءً مِنَ الشَّهْرِ المُقْبِلِ، بِهَدَفِ تَرْمِيمِ⁩ « ⁧المَكْتَبَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ⁩ » ⁧أَعْلَنَتْ بَلَدِيَّةُ مِيلَانُو أَمْسِ إِغْلَاقَ⁩
⁧المَبْنَى وَتَحْدِيثِ قَاعَاتِهِ. وَقَالَ النَّاطِقُ بِاسْمِ البَلَدِيَّةِ إِنَّ الأَعْمَالَ سَتَجْرِي عَلَى قَدَمٍ وَسَاقٍ، وَإِنَّ المَكْتَبَةَ⁩
⁧سَتَفْتَحُ أَبْوَابَهَا مِنْ جَدِيدٍ فِي الخَرِيفِ القَادِمِ.⁩
⁧وَرَغْمَ أَهَمِّيَّةِ المَشْرُوعِ، أَثَارَ القَرَارُ جَدَلًا بَيْنَ الطُّلَّابِ، إِذْ لَا تُوجَدُ فِي الحَيِّ قَاعَاتٌ أُخْرَى لِلدِّرَاسَةِ. أَمَّا البَلَدِيَّةُ⁩
⁧فَقَدْ وَعَدَتْ بِفَتْحِ قَاعَةٍ مُؤَقَّتَةٍ فِي مَدْرَسَةٍ قَرِيبَةٍ. وَأَفَادَتْ مَصَادِرُ مُطَّلِعَةٌ أَنَّ تَكْلِفَةَ الأَعْمَالِ تَبْلُغُ خَمْسَةَ⁩
⁧مَلَايِينِ يُورُو.⁩
⁧يُذْكَرُ أَنَّ المَكْتَبَةَ لَمْ تُرَمَّمْ مُنْذُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلَاثِينَ عَامًا.⁩

F · Oral production · tutor information

Accuracy. 4: reading without vowels with the right choices on ambiguous words (active/passive, form I/II) and clear explanation; correct source and passage formulas ( ⁧قَالَ⁩ … ⁧إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَفَادَ⁩ … ⁧أَنَّ⁩ ); Egyptian with correct imperatives, possessive suffixes and bitāʿ in the right place, ʿamm and ḫāl Not confused. 3: some mistakes that do not disturb. 2: frequent reading errors or formulas; Egyptian often mixed with the fuṣḥā. 1: The structure of the module is not controlled. Fluidity and pronunciation. 4: sliding reading, with pauses to the connectors; news told without long breaks. 3: some hesitation. 2: Frequent breaks. 1: the speech is often interrupted. Switch to module B1.4 with at least 38/50At least 2 in each criterion of parts E and F, and at least 6 points in Part D. Note also the reading speed of part A: if it is below 50 words per minute, continue with a timed reading per week during B1-21 and B1-22.
